## Summary

Describe the change, why it is needed, and which documentation or script targets were updated.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Clean-room tooling or parser update (`Dev/scripts/`)
- [ ] Schema, struct, or symbol catalog update (`Dev/schemas/`)
- [ ] Technical documentation or format specification (`Dev/docs/`, root docs)

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Offline Python checks / unit tests pass with zero warnings.
- [ ] JSON schemas and manifests parse cleanly without local workstation paths.

## Clean-Room Confirmation

- [ ] This pull request contains **zero** retail ROM images, extracted game assets, Ghidra `.gpr`/`.rep` databases, decompiled retail function bodies, or copyrighted game text.
